description.narrative: The purpose of this study is to gain knowledge that will allow us to design and implement a pilot project. Our vision for the project is to empower youth to participate in climate action. The youth in Zimbabwe constitute about 60% of the population. However, their participation in climate action has been limited. The goal of this preparatory study is thus to discover if this unutilized potential is caused by a knowledge gap on climate issues among Zimbabwean youth and if so how this gap impacts local communities and groups especially vulnerable to the consequences of climate change. We will do this by going on community visits and conducting surveys among the youth. Additionally we will meet with different Government Ministries to gain knowledge about climate and education trends in Zimbabwe as a whole. This will enable us to up-qualify young Zimbabweans, in climate advocacy. During this study, we will gather relevant information, data and practices for developing and implementing the subsequent pilot project.
